worldOverview.name: Sugarscape Survival
worldOverview.description: Cursed with an endless hunger and dropped into a world built entirely of dessert. Everything is edible — the hills, the surf, the wildlife that wants you gone — and every bite is a bargain with the curse. Eat enough to keep moving, resist enough to stay moving, and find the one place where the sweetness goes stale.
worldOverview.author: Formamorph
worldOverview.systemPrompt:
The player is trapped in the Sugarscape — a whimsical realm built entirely of dessert — and cursed with an unending hunger they picked up through {{ph:2a650c74-702d-442e-b822-4e99b26fd5f9:world:fb9541ab-53ed-440b-9962-e11634628260}}. The curse climbs on its own; everything here is edible; the way out is the one place nothing tastes good.

Rules:
- The player wins by reaching the Stalefront and crossing the seam of ordinary daylight there. Narrate that crossing as a triumphant finale.
- Craving is the curse: it rises relentlessly and falls when the player eats — anything. Show the pull vividly: watering mouth, drifting hands, bargaining. It whispers loudest about {{ph:1468962f-93be-4a8e-a7dc-69ed17e4e8be:world:bd660a6b-050f-44a9-8b7d-fe3556b7ad94}}.
- Fullness is the price. Every bite adds to it; high Fullness means waddling, and waddling means caught. Overindulgence, not injury, is how this world wins.
- Stickiness tracks the sugar coating the player: raise it for messy eating, gummy pools, and cyclone dunkings; lower it when they wash, especially in the cream surf. Creatures notice a sticky traveler — scale their interest to match.
- Entities do not speak or communicate with the player. They emote physically: wobbles, chirless bounces, re-piped icing arrows.
- The creatures are edible and their pieces have fixed effects — apply the effects described on the creature the player actually eats from.
- Tone: whimsical, comedic peril. Nobody bleeds and nothing dies horribly; defeat is sticky, stuffed, and embarrassing. Describe how the player fights the urge to eat everything — and, sometimes, how they give in.
- One odd detail of this place: {{ph:2abaf2e7-cc9c-4afc-a8a4-bf1336b0b753:world:b6501c29-2244-44f5-acb0-eee36d59a182}}. Let it surface now and then, never explained.
worldOverview.readme:
## Sugarscape Survival

The curse wants you to eat the world, and the world wants to eat you back. Somewhere past the color, the dessert goes stale — reach **the Stalefront** and cross into the gray to win.

**How to survive**
- **Craving** climbs on its own — the curse never sleeps. Eating anything quiets it for a while.
- **Fullness** is the price. Overstuffed means waddling, and waddling means caught.
- **Stamina** fuels running and climbing; cyclone tosses and pouncer rams will knock it out of you.
- Eat neatly. The sprinkle swarmers can tell — and the strawberry-cream surf washes off more than you'd think.
- **Gritted Teeth** can be switched on any time from your traits: the curse quiets while you white-knuckle it, but it's exhausting.
- The gingerbread wayposts never speak. They still know the way out.

Eat smart. Go gray.
worldOverview.introReadme:
🍰 **You woke up hungry. Not your hunger — *the* hunger.** A curse with a sweet tooth is riding your appetite through a world built entirely of dessert, and everything here is edible — including the things that bite back.

Before your first bite you'll pick who you are: an **Appetite** and a **Build** (one each), plus any **Pantry Tricks** (take as many as you like). They decide how loud the curse gets — and how much cake you can outrun. Each playthrough also rolls how you were cursed, what the curse whispers about, and one odd detail of the landscape.

Somewhere past the rainbow, the sweetness ends.
worldOverview.openingCue: I wake with my cheek in a hillside of ice cream and my mouth already watering. The hunger is awake too — I can feel it looking around through my eyes. Far off, past the rainbow, one strip of the horizon has no color at all.

stats.name: Health
stats.description: Represents the player's physical well-being and ability to sustain damage

descriptors.description: Critical condition. Severely battered, barely conscious, in real trouble.
Injured. Bruised and aching, movement impaired.
Hurt. Minor knocks and scrapes, some pain, but generally functional.
Healthy. No significant injuries, operating at full capacity.

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: Represents the player's energy and ability to perform physical actions

descriptors.description: Exhausted. Barely able to move, risk of collapse, unable to perform strenuous actions.
Tired. Movements are sluggish, difficulty in sustained physical activities.
Winded. Slightly out of breath, can perform most actions but not at peak efficiency.
Energetic. Full of energy, capable of performing any physical action without hindrance.

stats.name: Craving
stats.description: The curse of unending hunger. Climbs relentlessly on its own; eating anything quiets it for a while.

descriptors.description: Quiet. The hunger naps; thoughts are entirely the player's own.
Murmuring. Sweet smells keep finding the player; their mouth waters at nothing.
Roaring. The player's hands drift toward food on their own; resisting takes real, visible effort.
Ravenous. The curse takes the wheel — the player will eat the nearest edible thing unless something stops them.

stats.name: Fullness
stats.description: How much the player has eaten. Rises with every bite and falls slowly as they digest.

descriptors.description: Empty. Hollow and rumbling — the curse loves this.
Comfortable. Fed and fully mobile.
Full. Stretched and slower; jumping is a bad idea.
Overstuffed. Waddling at best — running is a fantasy, and the player mostly wants to lie down in the frosting.

stats.name: Stickiness
stats.description: How much sugar, syrup, and cream coats the player. Rises from messy eating, gummy pools, and sugar dust; falls when they wash, especially in the cream surf.

descriptors.description: Clean-ish. A dusting of powdered sugar; unremarkable to the wildlife.
Dusted. Tacky fingers, sparkling hair; a passing swarmer's antennae twitch toward the player.
Sticky. Trailing caramel threads; sprinkle swarmers change course toward the player.
A walking dessert. Syrup-coated head to toe — every creature in sight considers the player food.

locations.name: The Sugarscape
locations.playerDescription: A world baked, whipped, and frosted into place. All of it is food — and all of it knows you're hungry.
locations.aiDescription: The Sugarscape: a whimsical realm built entirely of dessert — ice cream hills, cream oceans, sugar-sand dunes, and one gray edge where the sweetness goes stale. Everything is edible, most of it is delicious, and some of it fights back. Its regions lie below.
locations.aiSummary: The Sugarscape: the all-dessert realm the player must escape.

locations.name: Sundaelora
locations.playerDescription: Ice cream hills and cookie-crumb ground, with wafer trees and gummy pools under a rainbow-sprinkle sky.
locations.aiDescription: Sundaelora, where the player woke: ice cream hills over cookie-crumb ground, giant half-melted chocolate bars, boulder cookies, gummy bear pools, wafer trees, and a rainbow-sprinkle sky. Sweet, dreamy, and crawling with things that ram, roll, and swarm.
locations.aiSummary: Sundaelora: ice cream hills and cookie ground, the starting region.

locations.name: Strawberrycream Shores
locations.playerDescription: A strawberry cream ocean on shortbread shores. The surf smells incredible — and washes off everything sticky.
locations.aiDescription: The Strawberrycream Shores: a vast strawberry cream ocean lapping shortbread shores strewn with macaron seashells, waffle cone towers, and floating gummy candies under cotton candy clouds. Washing in the cream surf rinses away stuck-on sugar and syrup — the one bath that works here.
locations.aiSummary: Strawberrycream Shores: cream ocean and shortbread beach; the surf washes stickiness away.

locations.name: The Candy Dunes
locations.playerDescription: Rolling sugar-sand and hard-candy outcrops. Peppermint pouncers own these hills, and strange salt boulders sit half-buried.
locations.aiDescription: The Candy Dunes: rolling dunes of loose sugar-sand studded with hard-candy outcrops and half-buried saltlick stones. Peppermint Pouncers hold territory here and charge intruders on sight. Walking the loose sugar is tiring, and it dusts everything it touches.
locations.imageTags: candy desert, sugar sand dunes, striped hard candy rocks, pastel sky, whimsical

locations.name: The Stalefront
locations.playerDescription: The edge of everything sweet: cracked fondant, drained colors, air that tastes of cardboard. The hunger goes quiet here.
locations.aiDescription: The Stalefront: the gray edge of the Sugarscape, where fondant cracks, colors drain, and the air tastes of cardboard. The curse goes noticeably quiet here. A door-shaped seam of plain, ordinary daylight stands in the stale crust — crossing through it ends the ordeal; narrate that crossing as a triumphant finale.
locations.imageTags: gray stale dessert landscape, cracked fondant ground, drained colors, doorway of plain daylight

connections.aiHint: down the fudge creekbed to the shore
over the wafer ridge where the sprinkles thin out
following the saltlick stones as the colors drain away
along the crust where the cream turns to skin

entities.name: Cream Cyclone
entities.playerDescription: A wandering tornado of whipped cream. It is not aiming at you. It does not need to.
entities.aiDescription: The Cream Cyclone: a swirling tornado of whipped cream that wanders the hills and shores, sucking up whatever it touches. Being caught means being tossed, spun dizzy, and set down coated head to toe in cream — Stamina knocked out, Stickiness soaked in, dignity gone, but never real injury. It cannot be fought, only dodged.
entities.aiSummary: Cream Cyclone: wandering whipped-cream tornado; tosses and coats its victims, never truly harms.
entities.imageTags: whipped cream tornado, swirling white cyclone, candy landscape, dramatic sky

entities.name: Gummy Bear
entities.playerDescription: An adult-sized gummy bear smelling of raspberry. Slow, wobbly, and very interested in hugging you.
entities.aiDescription: The Gummy Bear: a towering, translucent-red gummy bear radiating raspberry sweetness. Slow but relentless, it swipes with stretchy limbs and traps intruders in clumsy, crushing bear hugs. Its gelatin body shrugs off blows, but sustained effort tears chunks free — and the chunks are delicious: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness and Stickiness.
entities.aiSummary: Gummy Bear: slow hugging hulk; torn-off chunks are edible (craving down, fullness and stickiness up).
entities.imageTags: giant red gummy bear, translucent, candy hills, cute but menacing

entities.name: Peppermint Pouncer
entities.playerDescription: An adorable striped puffball that charges headfirst at anything crossing its dune. The center is not soft.
entities.aiDescription: The Peppermint Pouncer: a plump, huggable-looking striped creature that bounces across the Candy Dunes and rams intruders headfirst. Its marshmallow-soft body hides a rock-hard peppermint core — a ram knocks the wind out (Stamina loss, comic tumbles, no lasting harm). Shards it sheds on impact are intensely refreshing: eating one drops Craving sharply with barely any Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Peppermint Pouncer: territorial rammer; its shed shards drop craving sharply with little fullness.
entities.imageTags: round striped peppermint creature, red and white, cute aggressive puffball, candy dunes

entities.name: Sprinkle Swarmers
entities.playerDescription: Clouds of living rainbow sprinkles. They can tell exactly how sticky you are, and they act on it.
entities.aiDescription: Sprinkle Swarmers: tiny, fast creatures made of rainbow sprinkles that attack in chattering clouds. They are drawn to sweetness on a traveler — the stickier the player, the bolder and larger the swarm — clinging, nibbling, and weighing hair and clothes down with yet more sugar. A clean traveler barely interests them. Individually they are delicious, if the player can stand eating something that wriggles.
entities.aiSummary: Sprinkle Swarmers: sprinkle clouds drawn to sticky travelers; harmless-ish, relentless, edible.
entities.imageTags: swarm of living rainbow sprinkles, tiny creatures with eyes, candy landscape

entities.name: Cookie Brawler
entities.playerDescription: A boulder-sized cookie that attacks by rolling at you. Its aim is enthusiastic rather than good.
entities.aiDescription: The Cookie Brawler: a massive spherical chocolate-chip cookie that patrols the ice cream hills and attacks by rolling at alarming speed. Its charges are dangerous but poorly aimed — they usually end with it wedged comically in a hillside, where it wobbles furiously until it works free. Chips knocked loose in a crash are simply excellent cookie: eating one lowers Craving and raises Fullness.
entities.aiSummary: Cookie Brawler: rolling boulder cookie, comically bad aim; loose chips are good eating.
entities.imageTags: giant spherical chocolate chip cookie, rolling boulder, ice cream hills

entities.name: Gingerbread Waypost
entities.playerDescription: A gingerbread figure on a candy-cane post. Its icing arrow re-pipes itself while you watch. It has never once spoken.
entities.aiDescription: The Gingerbread Wayposts: gingerbread figures mounted on candy-cane posts, found across the Sugarscape. Each one's icing arrow slowly re-pipes itself to point toward the Stalefront. Like everything here they never speak — they only point, patiently, and a few bear polite nibble marks from travelers who came before.
entities.aiSummary: Gingerbread Waypost: mute signpost whose icing arrow always points toward the Stalefront.
entities.imageTags: gingerbread man signpost, candy cane pole, icing arrow, whimsical candy road sign

entities.name: Saltlick Stones
entities.playerDescription: Boulders of pure salt, untouched by all the sweetness. One lick and the hunger goes very, very quiet.
entities.aiDescription: The Saltlick Stones: rough boulders of pure salt, weirdly immune to the surrounding sweetness — nothing sugary grows near them and the creatures give them a wide berth. Licking one scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard with no Fullness at all. It tastes like tears and victory.
entities.aiSummary: Saltlick Stones: salt boulders; licking drops craving hard with zero fullness, creatures avoid them.
entities.imageTags: white salt boulders, half buried in candy sand, stark against pastel colors

traits.name: Grazer
traits.playerDescription: Little and often. The curse stays drowsy if you keep it snacking.
traits.aiDescription: The player manages the curse by grazing — small bites, often. The hunger builds noticeably slower for them.

traits.name: Glutton
traits.playerDescription: Go big. You can pack it away like a champion — and the curse loves you for it.
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat enormous amounts in one sitting before feeling it — but the curse burns hotter in them.

traits.name: Iron Will
traits.playerDescription: You've told it no before. It costs you.
traits.aiDescription: The player resists the curse better than anyone — the hunger builds slowly — but the constant refusal wears them down.

traits.name: Nimble
traits.playerDescription: Quick over the crumb fields, quicker up a wafer tree.
traits.aiDescription: The player is quick and light on their feet, recovering breath fast between sprints.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.playerDescription: Takes a pouncer ram like a compliment.
traits.aiDescription: The player is solidly built — they shrug off rams, tumbles, and cyclone landings that would flatten others.

traits.name: Featherlight
traits.playerDescription: Cyclones throw you further — but you land softer.
traits.aiDescription: The player is unusually light: fast and far-jumping, tossed further by cyclones and rams but landing soft. Less mass to absorb a real hit.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.aiDescription: The player can eat far past the point most people would burst, staying mobile where others would be waddling.

traits.name: Hearty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: Meals actually satisfy you. The curse hates that.
traits.aiDescription: Food genuinely satisfies the player — every meal quiets the curse longer than it should.

traits.name: Sugar Rush
traits.playerDescription: Everything you eat hits like rocket fuel — and burns off just as fast.
traits.aiDescription: Sugar hits the player like rocket fuel: bursts of speed and energy after eating, with a hunger that comes back sooner.

traits.name: Gritted Teeth
traits.playerDescription: White-knuckle the curse into silence. It works. It costs.
traits.aiDescription: ACTIVE: the player is actively white-knuckling the curse — jaw set, fists closed, refusing every smell. The craving quiets while this holds, but the effort is visibly exhausting.

dictionaries.name: The Sugarscape Survival Guide
dictionaries.description: House rules of the dessert realm: the curse, the wildlife, and the one gray way out.

entries.name: House Rules
entries.value: The Sugarscape is whimsical, comedic peril — Wonka-logic, not horror. Nothing here speaks, nobody bleeds, and defeat means being stuck, stuffed, swept up, or swarmed, never injured gore. Describe food with loving, dangerous vividness: the deliciousness of the world is its best weapon.

entries.name: The Curse
entries.value: The curse of unending hunger climbs on its own and never sleeps. Show it as a pull, not a voice: watering mouth, drifting hands, bargaining thoughts. Eating anything — anything — quiets it for a while and adds Fullness (plus Stickiness if it's messy). Giving in occasionally is human; narrate it with sympathy and comedy, not shame.

entries.name: Everything Is Edible
entries.value: Every structure and creature in the Sugarscape is edible and tastes wonderful. Describe flavor and texture in loving detail. Eating quiets Craving and raises Fullness; messy eating coats the player in more sugar.

entries.name: The Cream Surf
entries.value: Washing in the strawberry-cream surf rinses away stuck-on sugar and syrup — the one bath in this world that leaves a person cleaner than it found them. It also smells like the best dessert ever made, which the curse notices immediately.

entries.name: Swarmer Sense
entries.value: Sprinkle Swarmers read sweetness the way sharks read blood. A clean traveler is boring; a sticky one is a parade float. The swarm scales with how sugar-coated the player is.

entries.name: The Stalefront
entries.value: At the Stalefront the world goes gray, the fondant cracks, and everything tastes of cardboard — and the curse falls quiet for the first time. The door-shaped seam of ordinary daylight in the crust is the way out: crossing it ends the ordeal. Narrate the crossing as a triumphant finale, ending on the first bite of real, savory food.

entries.name: Saltlick
entries.value: Licking a saltlick stone scours the curse quiet: Craving drops hard, no Fullness gained. It is the only relief in this world that costs nothing but pride.

entries.name: Wayposts
entries.value: The gingerbread wayposts' icing arrows always end up pointing toward the Stalefront, re-piping themselves when no one watches closely. They never speak — nothing here does — but they have never once pointed wrong.
